name: Rigel Forms
author: Walstar Technologies

sections.description:
Rigel Forms is a powerful, developer-friendly form builder designed to be lightweight and incredibly fast. Unlike heavy page-builder forms, Rigel Forms gives you total control over your HTML while providing a premium experience for managing submissions and styling.

Features

  • Template Library: Launch forms instantly with pre-built templates for Contact, Newsletters, RSVPs, and more.
  • Submission Dashboard: Track every message with a dedicated, interactive “Enquiries” dashboard and submission counters.
  • Native HTML Builder: Write pure HTML or use our one-click tag inserter.
  • Pro Visual Styling: Customize every detail—colors, input padding, border radius, button widths, and text typography—with native WordPress color pickers.
  • Built-in Spam Protection: Google reCAPTCHA v3 and Akismet integration included as standard.
  • API Integrations: Seamlessly sync your form leads with Brevo (Sendinblue).

External services

This plugin relies on the following third-party services to function properly:

  1. Google reCAPTCHA v3

– Purpose: Used to prevent automated spam submissions on your forms.
– Data Sent: User IP address and browser interaction data are sent to Google when a form is submitted to calculate a spam score.
– Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  1. Brevo API

– Purpose: Used to automatically add form submitters to your Brevo mailing list (if an API key is provided in the settings).
– Data Sent: Form data (Name, Email, Phone, etc.) is securely transmitted to the Brevo API upon form submission.
– Terms of Service: https://www.brevo.com/legal/termsofuse/
– Privacy Policy: https://www.brevo.com/legal/privacypolicy/
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard and navigate to ‘Plugins’ -> ‘Add New’.
  2. Search for ‘Rigel Forms’ in the search bar.
  3. Click ‘Install Now’ and then ‘Activate’.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip file from the WordPress repository.
  2. Go to ‘Plugins’ -> ‘Add New’ -> ‘Upload Plugin’ and upload the .zip file.
  3. Click ‘Install Now’ and then ‘Activate’.

Getting Started

  1. Once activated, a new ‘Rigel Forms’ menu will appear in your dashboard.
  2. Go to ‘Rigel Forms’ -> ‘Add New Form’ to choose a starting template.
  3. Customize your fields and visual styling.
  4. Copy the generated Shortcode [rigel_forms id="X"] and paste it into any page, post, or Gutenberg block.
sections.faq:
Can I use my own CSS?

Yes! You can easily style your forms using our comprehensive visual styling controls, or by targeting the .rigel-form-main-container class inside the native WordPress ‘Additional CSS’ Customizer panel.

Where are the submissions stored?

Submissions are stored safely in your WordPress database under the “Enquiries” menu.
